_comment: Hand-written game setup tables. Map sizes and speeds from specs/civ6/data/game-setup.md (maxReligions: Great Prophets per map size); starting units from its 'Starting units (major civs)' Ancient row. Globals here are Sovereign-only tuning: CITY_SIGHT_RANGE (Civ VI value unverified, 01-map-and-terrain.md Visibility) the MAPGEN_* map generator knobs, CITY_PRODUCTION_QUEUE_MAX (Civ value unverified), GOLD_PURCHASE_ENGINE_FACTOR (gold price = production cost x GOLD_PURCHASE_MULTIPLIER x this, giving the 4x of 02-cities.md, Production), EXPERIENCE_PER_LEVEL (XP for the next promotion = this x current level; engine value per 05-units-and-combat.md, XP and promotions) BARBARIAN_CAMP_CLEAR_GOLD (gold for clearing a camp; Civ amount unverified, 01-map-and-terrain.md Barbarians), BARBARIAN_MAX_UNITS_PER_CAMP (a camp stops releasing units at this many; Sovereign cap, Civ VI uses attack forces) CITY_STRENGTH_BELOW_STRONGEST_UNIT (city strength = strongest unit built minus this; engine value per 02-cities.md, City combat) and TRADE_ROUTE_PLUNDER_GOLD (gold for plundering a trade route; Civ amount unverified, 07-economy-trade-great-people.md Trade routes).
